port_access_audit.next_weight_load: 384 cycles at 32B/cycle, followed serially by generator reads

two_accumulator_single_pwp_port_prefetch.description: prefetch a nonresident next parent while the current edge has spare cycles; only nonresident distance-1 edges add a parent-fetch cycle

one_accumulator_sync_single_pwp_port.description: every nonresident parent has an explicit 144B synchronous read before edge updates

p0.finding: M275 calls the result exact and port-feasible, but a tree child requires a parent PWP read that is absent from both the physical-port contract and the analyzer. A valid synchronous single-port, one-accumulator realization gives 707 rather than 675 cold-start cycles and 352,332,590 rather than 352,332,270 total cycles.
p0.impact: The exact total and 357-cycle minimum slack are conditional on an unstated 144B 1R1W PWP bank or a two-accumulator parent-prefetch schedule. M275r2 must freeze and replay one of those implementations. The stronger zero in-sample transition-stall result survives the stress model.

p1.finding: The 61,440-byte capacity counts only two weight and two PWP banks. It omits 192 bytes of double-buffered patterns/descriptors and 144 or 288 bytes of generator accumulator/prefetch state.
p1.impact: Present 61,440 bytes as bank capacity, not complete module capacity; use at least 61,776 or 61,920 bytes before control/decode state.

p1.finding: A 96-lane signed12 generator, 96B weight reads and 144B PWP macro accesses have no RTL, SRAM macro, DC or energy evidence.
p1.impact: Port width, area, Fmax and net energy remain unadmitted even though the phase slack is large.

p1.finding: The 1.540570x and 18.833241x ratios compare the complete modeled PWP Conv path with bit-sparse and dense references. Tree materialization itself changes stored-PWP cycles by only 1.00000809x.
p1.impact: Do not attribute the large module ratios to the tree materializer contribution.

p2.finding: The two-cycle role switch is logically sufficient after at least 333 cycles of stress-model slack, but SRAM read latency, valid fencing and role-bit timing are not executable.
p2.impact: Keep it as a modeled tail until an FSM/RTL or explicit event trace exists.

p2.finding: M275 binds M251 r1 but not the M251r2 correction of the full signed-INT8 PWP lower endpoint from -2032 to -2048.
p2.impact: Cycles are unchanged, but the next contract should bind M251r2 to avoid reviving stale range prose.

p2.finding: Zero exposed transition stalls excludes cold-start cost by definition; the one-accumulator stress changes only cold starts while all 17,270 transitions remain hidden.
p2.impact: Report transition stalls and total cycles separately.

publication_wording.safe: On the exact ten-sample four-Conv trace, the modeled PWP path is 1.54057x faster than the matched bit-sparse reference and 18.83324x faster than dense. Hamming-tree materialization eliminates 31.85 MB of modeled fixed-PWP payload, and independent parent-fetch stress models expose no in-sample transition stalls. The exact 352,332,270-cycle total requires an explicit 144B 1R1W or two-accumulator prefetch implementation.
forbidden: the tree materializer itself provides 1.54x or 18.83x speedup
unqualified exact 352,332,270 port-feasible cycles before M275r2
measured DRAM, SRAM, area, energy, system speedup, PPA or headline

required_m275r2: Freeze either a 144B 1R1W next-PWP macro contract or the two-accumulator single-port prefetch schedule.
Emit parent read, child write, weight read, metadata load, bank-valid and role-switch events for every tree edge and phase.
Count 192 metadata bytes and 144/288 accumulator bytes in complete capacity.
Bind M251r2 and keep the large speedups attributed to the full isolated Conv module rather than materialization alone.
